output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply and mintedAmount parameters are not checked for overflow, allowing the owner to set the balance of any user to any value, if exploited, it can make the token unusable and devalue it.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value parameter is not checked for overflow, allowing attackers to overflow balanceOf of a target user, if exploited, it can make the token unusable and devalue it.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value parameter is not checked for overflow, allowing attackers to overflow balanceOf of a target user, if exploited, it can make the token unusable and devalue it.

The approve function has a wrong logic vulnerability. It directly adds _value to the allowance mapping without checking if it causes an overflow, if exploited, it can cause unexpected additional token to be generated.

The approveAndCall function has a wrong logic vulnerability. It directly adds _value to the allowance mapping of _spender without checking if it causes an overflow, if exploited, it can cause unexpected additional token to be generated.
